items.title_en: Оптимизация сайта под нейросети
items.summary_en: «Спросил у ChatGPT про вашу компанию — он назвал трех конкурентов». Если вы работаете с сайтами, такую фразу вы слышали уже не раз. При этом сайт в топе, трафик из поиска идет, конверсии в порядке. А нейросеть либо не знает о вас, либо рассказывает о компании по данным двухлетней давности. Первая реакция — переписать тексты, добавить экспертизы, оформить FAQ. Мы проходили этот путь: гипотеза про «мало контента» выглядит логично, но почти никогда не подтверждается. Отвечает нейросеть не по вашему тексту, а по тому, что до нее дошло. И вот тут начинается самое интересное. Когда мы прогнали свой сайт через запросы к разным моделям и посмотрели, что именно получает их инфраструктура, картина оказалась прозаичной. Часть ИИ-краулеров не исполняет JavaScript. Для сайта, который собирается в браузере, это означает одно: до модели вместо статьи доезжает пустой каркас. Пользователь видит прекрасную страницу, а нейросеть — пустой файл. В этой статье разберем, как устроено чтение сайтов системами ИИ, где контент теряется на пути от сервера к ответу модели и что из этого можно проверить и починить. Читать далее

items.title_en: ИИ-агент почти без ИИ: в моём сметчике нейросеть не посчитала ни рубля
items.summary_en: В продукте, который называется «ИИ-сметчик», нейросеть пока не посчитала ни рубля. Компания по ремонту и отделке квартир в Москве дала мне пять рабочих смет. По ним система выдала 310 замечаний (прогоны 16–21.08.2026). Самая дорогая находка — общий итог одной сметы занижен на 515 786 ₽ . Это занижение нашлось ещё при обследовании смет перед ТЗ, а правило под него я написал потом, так что здесь заслуга внимательного чтения, а не кода. Код интереснее другим: 51 подтверждённое замечание он выдал сверх эталонного списка ошибок, составленного при том обследовании. В списке их не было. Все 310 замечаний выдаёт код с правилами. ИИ-слой написан и покрыт тестами на заглушке, но на живой модели ещё не запускался: ключа доступа нет, платформу выбирает заказчик. Рабочую версию я ему передал, и она обходится без интернета. Во второй системе, конфигураторе замеров для сервиса, который готовит чертежи стеклянных душевых кабин под заказ, нейросети нет совсем. Модель в обоих проектах работала у меня в разработке: писала код, разбирала Excel заказчика, сверяла замечания со строками смет. В сам продукт я пускаю её только туда, где без неё нельзя. items.title_en: MEXC Brings AI, TradFi and the Future of Trading to Life at TOKEN2049 Singapore
items.summary_en: Mutsamudu, Comoros, October 12, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, concluded its TOKEN2049 Singapore presence with a series of interactive experiences and industry discussions spanning TradFi access, AI-powered trading and the future evolution of global trading platforms. MEXC’s presence centered on three key areas: the MEXC Stage and a panel featuring MEXC CEO Vugar Usi Zade and Payward Co-CEO Arjun Sethi, hands-on AI experiences including the MEXC AI Trading Challenge powered by MEXC CLI and the AI Bond Test, and The NEXT Newspaper, an interactive experience that brought insights around TradFi, AI and the future of investing into a more engaging community format. Thousands of participants joined MEXC’s on-site activities during the event, reflecting strong interest in both AI-enabled trading and broader access to traditional financial markets. Across the booth and the MEXC Stage, these themes came together around a broader question: how trading platforms can become more connected, accessible and intelligent as crypto and traditional finance continue to converge. Exploring AI Through Hands-On Experiences AI was one of the most visible themes across the MEXC booth. Through the MEXC AI Trading Challenge, visitors experienced how natural-language instructions, AI agents and MEXC CLI can work together to move trading ideas more directly from analysis to action. The experience demonstrated how users can express what they want to do in everyday language, while AI agents supported by MEXC CLI connect those intentions with MEXC trading capabilities. Alongside the trading experience, the AI Bond Test offered a more playful way for visitors to explore their relationship with AI, including how they use, trust and interact with AI in everyday decision-making. Together, the two activities reflected growing interest not only in AI as an information or research tool, but also in how it could become a more natural part of the broader trading experience.   Bringing TradFi Insights Into the Community Traditional financial markets were another major area of interest at TOKEN2049. Through The NEXT Newspaper, MEXC transformed research insights around AI, trading and global markets into an interactive experience. Visitors could personalize their own newspaper with their photo and predictions about the future of investing, creating a bridge between research, market trends and community participation. The activation reflected a broader shift in retail investing as users increasingly look beyond crypto toward stocks, commodities and other traditional financial assets, while expecting to access these opportunities through more seamless digital platforms.   From Crypto-TradFi Convergence to Platform Collaboration These themes also extended to the MEXC Stage, where MEXC CEO Vugar Usi Zade joined Payward Co-CEO Arjun Sethi. The panel explored how crypto and traditional finance are moving toward a more connected, always-on financial environment, and how retail demand could help drive the evolution toward platforms that provide access across multiple asset classes. Arjun highlighted the infrastructure needed to support this evolution, noting that the promise of 24/7 markets ultimately depends on connecting assets and collateral more effectively. Collaboration was another key theme. Arjun pointed to partnerships as an important part of reaching more global users, specifically referencing MEXC as an example of a platform that could help partners succeed in their respective core markets. Vugar similarly highlighted how platforms can build on different strengths across infrastructure, market access and retail distribution rather than approaching every opportunity purely through competition. AI also featured in the discussion as part of the longer-term evolution of trading. Vugar noted that AI can help retail users process large amounts of information more efficiently and convert insights into action, while increasingly agentic tools could further change how users interact with financial platforms. From hands-on AI experiences to TradFi engagement and conversations about the future of market infrastructure, MEXC’s TOKEN2049 presence reflected a broader direction for trading: more connected markets, broader access and increasingly intelligent ways for users to participate.   For more highlights from TOKEN2049 Singapore, watch the event recap video.   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway. With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.   MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com Source   Risk Disclaimer: This content does not constitute investment advice. items.title_ru: MEXC представила AI, традиционные финансы и будущее торговли на TOKEN2049 в Сингапуре.
items.summary_ru:
Mutsamudu, Коморы, 12 октября 2026 года – MEXC, пионер в торговле цифровыми активами без комиссий, завершил свое участие в TOKEN2049 в Сингапуре серией интерактивных мероприятий и обсуждений в отрасли, охватывающих доступ к традиционным финансам, торговлю с использованием ИИ и будущее глобальных торговых платформ. Присутствие MEXC сосредоточилось на трех ключевых областях: сцене MEXC и панели с участием генерального директора MEXC Вугара Уси Заде и со-генерального директора Payward Арджуна Сети, практическом опыте с ИИ, включая MEXC AI Trading Challenge, поддерживаемый MEXC CLI, и AI Bond Test, а также The NEXT Newspaper, интерактивном опыте, который предоставил инсайты о традиционных финансах, ИИ и будущем инвестирования в более увлекательном формате для сообщества. Тысячи участников присоединились к мероприятиям MEXC на месте во время события, что отражает высокий интерес как к торговле с использованием ИИ, так и к более широкому доступу к традиционным финансовым рынкам. На стенде и сцене MEXC эти темы объединялись вокруг более широкого вопроса: как торговые платформы могут стать более связанными, доступными и интеллектуальными по мере того, как крипто и традиционные финансы продолжают сливаться. 

Изучение ИИ через практический опыт ИИ был одной из самых заметных тем на стенде MEXC. Через MEXC AI Trading Challenge посетители узнали, как инструкции на естественном языке, ИИ-агенты и MEXC CLI могут работать вместе, чтобы более напрямую переводить торговые идеи из анализа в действие. Этот опыт продемонстрировал, как пользователи могут выражать свои намерения на повседневном языке, в то время как ИИ-агенты, поддерживаемые MEXC CLI, связывают эти намерения с торговыми возможностями MEXC. Наряду с торговым опытом, AI Bond Test предложил более игривый способ для посетителей исследовать свои отношения с ИИ, включая то, как они используют, доверяют и взаимодействуют с ИИ в повседневном принятии решений. Вместе эти два мероприятия отражали растущий интерес не только к ИИ как инструменту для получения информации или исследований, но и к тому, как он может стать более естественной частью более широкого торгового опыта.

items.title_en: Пять инженерных решений, которые нужно принять до генерации кода с AI
items.summary_en: В собственном маркетплейсе я однажды обнаружил ошибку в обработчике платежей. Логика выглядела правильной: проверить статус PENDING, перевести операцию в SUCCESS и начислить баланс. Но при одновременной обработке двух webhook’ов оба запроса могли пройти проверку и начислить деньги дважды. Этот код я написал сам, без AI. Сегодня AI-агент может реализовать такой обработчик за минуты. Но функционального описания недостаточно, чтобы гарантировать корректность при конкурентных запросах. Кто должен определить эти ограничения и сформулировать требования до начала разработки? На пяти ситуациях из собственного маркетплейса и мультибрендовой платформы разбираю, какие решения приходится принимать заранее: идемпотентность платежей, миграции данных, доставка сообщений между экземплярами сервиса, интеграции провайдеров и архитектура брендов. В конце — чек-лист из 12 вопросов перед генерацией кода. Читать далее

items.title_en: From TOKEN2049 to Ecosystem Co-Building: HTX Advances Its Multifaceted Engagement Across the Global Crypto Industry
items.summary_en: Singapore, October 12, 2026 – From October 6 to 8, the global crypto industry turned its attention to Singapore for TOKEN2049, a major international industry event. Taking advantage of the gathering, HTX pursued a multifaceted approach encompassing global industry engagement, ecosystem development, and brand awareness. HTX Ventures exhibited at TOKEN2049, where its booth welcomed a steady stream of visitors. HTX DAO hosted “Future Night” and “HTX DAO Reunion,” bringing together industry perspectives and community voices. Meanwhile, a private industry dinner provided an opportunity for invited industry participants, ecosystem contributors, and partners to connect and exchange views. From the public stage of a global summit to in-depth exchanges with ecosystem participants and face-to-face conversations with industry peers, HTX’s presence at TOKEN2049 reflected diverse efforts in industry networking, ecosystem development, and partnership building. Beyond providing opportunities for international industry engagement, these events reflected HTX’s ongoing efforts to strengthen industry connections and foster ecosystem collaboration. Taking the Global Crypto Stage: Strong Visitor Interest at the HTX Ventures Booth As a major annual event for the global crypto industry, TOKEN2049 brings together project teams, investment firms, developers, crypto exchanges, and industry builders from around the world. It serves as an important platform for tracking industry trends, forging business connections, and exploring opportunities for global collaboration. From October 7-8, HTX Ventures, HTX’s global investment arm, exhibited at TOKEN2049 at the Sands Expo and Convention Center in Singapore, with its booth located at Level 5, PB5-47 and PB5-48. Throughout the event, the exhibition floor remained busy, drawing a steady stream of industry participants. The HTX Ventures booth welcomed numerous visitors, offering an engaging, interactive brand experience through brand displays, on-site community activities , and branded merchandise. These activities encouraged visitors to stop by and connect with the team, bringing the HTX brand into face-to-face interactions with members of the global crypto community.   Meanwhile, Justin Sun, Advisor to HTX, attended related events and delivered a speech before visiting the HTX Ventures booth to engage with the team and other industry participants, further strengthening HTX’s connections with the global crypto industry. For the crypto industry, the value of an international summit lies not only in raising brand awareness but also in building meaningful connections with industry participants. By combining booth displays, on-site activities, and industry engagement, HTX Ventures brought the brand closer to the global crypto community, creating more opportunities for connections across the investment ecosystem, project discussions, and potential partnerships. From steady visitor traffic at its booth to a diverse range of on-site activities, HTX Ventures maintained a strong presence at TOKEN2049, providing HTX with another valuable opportunity to strengthen its connections across the global crypto industry. From Industry Trends to Ecosystem Development: HTX DAO Advances Community Co-Building While the TOKEN2049 booth served as HTX’s brand showcase to the global crypto industry, the series of events hosted by HTX DAO took these conversations further, exploring broader topics such as industry trends, community building, and ecosystem development. On the evening of October 6, HTX DAO hosted the “Future Night” event in Singapore. Molly, an HTX DAO ambassador, shared the latest developments in ecosystem mechanisms, community building, and the on-chain ecosystem. Justin Sun, a core supporter of HTX DAO, delivered a video address sharing his perspectives on trends in the crypto industry and the future development of the digital economy. Sun noted that the crypto industry is deepening its ties with traditional finance, driving the continued digital transformation of global financial infrastructure. AI is changing how wealth is created, while crypto and digital finance are reshaping how wealth is held and transferred. He further noted that stablecoins could play a greater role in global payments and settlements, while the use of traditional assets such as bonds, funds and gold on-chain will continue to evolve. As AI agents become increasingly involved in economic activity, demand for digital identities, account infrastructure, and the ability to transact autonomously is also likely to grow. In his view, the long-term value of technology lies in its ability to deliver tangible productivity gains. The free flow of value in the digital world will be a key trend to watch over the next decade. On ecosystem development, Molly said HTX DAO is exploring potential token utility and ecosystem applications, alongside other initiatives aimed at supporting the development of its ecosystem. For community building, HTX DAO plans to establish regional community hubs in the fourth quarter, enabling members to organize events, exchange ideas, and contribute to the development of the community’s culture. Nearly 200 active volunteers are already contributing to these efforts on their own initiative. To strengthen its on-chain ecosystem, HTX DAO is engaging university developers from around the world through initiatives such as hackathons. Several projects are currently being explored or developed, including potential applications within the $HTX ecosystem. Molly emphasized that ecosystem development requires a long-term commitment. HTX DAO will continue to strengthen its infrastructure, foster an active community, and drive the adoption of ecosystem applications. As an ecosystem participant, HTX continues to gather user feedback and explore improvements to its platform and user experience, with a view to better understanding and responding to evolving user needs. From discussions on industry trends to practical initiatives in community development and the on-chain ecosystem, the Future Night event highlighted HTX DAO’s sustained commitment to long-term ecosystem development health and provided a platform for global community members and industry contributors to connect and collaborate. III. From Online Communities to In-Person Gatherings: The HTX DAO Reunion Strengthens Ecosystem Connections Ecosystem growth depends not only on mechanisms and technology, but also on trust among community members and sustained collaboration among participants united by shared goals. From October 6 to 8, HTX DAO hosted the HTX DAO Reunion, bringing together industry representatives, ecosystem partners, and community members aboard a yacht for face-to-face discussions in an informal setting. Unlike traditional conferences built around structured agendas and formal presentations, the event created a more informal setting for participants to exchange views on industry trends, community development, and potential collaborations, fostering a deeper mutual understanding. For a DAO ecosystem to develop sustainably, community means more than online discussions and on-chain governance. It also depends on meaningful personal connections, ongoing exchanges, and active participation. By creating more diverse opportunities for in-person engagement, HTX DAO is strengthening its ties with community members and partners, opening up new possibilities for community-driven development, ecosystem collaboration, and future partnerships. From themed discussions to open exchanges, and from online participation to in-person engagement, HTX DAO is exploring diverse approaches to community building and continually strengthening connections among ecosystem participants. VIP Industry Gathering: Strengthening Face-to-Face Engagement with Ecosystem and Industry Partners Alongside public engagement with the global industry, HTX also made strengthening relationships with industry peers and partners a priority during Singapore Week. During the week, HTX hosted a private industry dinner attended by invited industry representatives, ecosystem contributors, and partners. Compared with large industry summits, private gatherings provide a more personal setting for direct conversations. These face-to-face interactions allow HTX to listen more closely to partners and exchange views on industry developments, market developments and potential future collaborations. As the crypto industry evolves, fostering industry relationships requires an understanding of ecosystem developments, effective communication, and the cultivation of long-term partnerships. Face-to-face engagement helps build mutual understanding, laying the groundwork for expanded collaboration across the sector. From industry discussions at the global summit to in-depth conversations in private settings, HTX is continuously strengthening its relationships with industry partners through engagement at multiple levels. Driving Long-Term Growth Through Global Engagement: HTX Expands Ecosystem Collaboration Throughout TOKEN2049 Singapore Week, HTX engaged across multiple fronts, including global industry dialogue, ecosystem development, brand visibility, and industry networking. HTX Ventures leveraged the international summit to expand its industry network and boost brand engagement through booth activities and in-person interactions. HTX DAO explored industry trends, community building, and the on-chain ecosystem, strengthening connections with community members and developers. Meanwhile, a series of in-person events and private industry gatherings provided further opportunities for HTX to engage with industry peers, ecosystem contributors, and partners.   While each initiative served a different purpose, they all contributed to the same overarching goal of building broader, deeper, and more enduring industry relationships as the global crypto industry continues to evolve. For participants in the crypto industry, brand influence stems not only from market visibility but also from sustained engagement in industry development, responsiveness to user needs, and efforts to foster collaboration among communities, projects, and partners. Looking ahead, HTX intends to continue its engagement with industry participants, ecosystem contributors, and partners, while exploring opportunities for ecosystem collaboration and platform improvements, subject to applicable regulatory requirements. By strengthening connections among global communities, developers, projects, and industry partners, HTX aims to explore new opportunities for the development of digital finance and blockchain ecosystems. From the global industry stage to the front lines of ecosystem development, HTX will continue to bring industry participants together through open collaboration and drive ecosystem growth through long-term commitment. items.title_en: Универсальный взломщик

Но зато есть дизассемблеры – инструменты перевода двоичного кода в ассемблер, язык очень низкоуровневый, но все же людям доступный. Используются они во всяких расшифровщиках и вирусах-антивирусах, когда нужно разобраться в узком месте чужого ПО и цена понимания высока. Обычную продуктовую разработку дешевле вести самому, чем подсматривать у конкурента таким способом: ассемблер – язык тяжелый.
